sn7.3:1.1: On one occasion the Blessed One was dwelling at Rājagaha in the Bamboo Grove, the Squirrel Sanctuary.
sn7.3:1.3: “It is said that the brahmin of the Bhāradvāja clan has gone forth from the household life into homelessness under the ascetic Gotama.” Angry and displeased, he approached the Blessed One and abused and reviled him with rude, harsh words.
sn7.3:1.4: When he had finished speaking, the Blessed One remained silent.
sn7.3:1.5: Then the brahmin Asurindaka Bhāradvāja said to the Blessed One:
sn7.3:2.2: When, by speech, he bellows harshly;
sn7.3:2.4: Patient endurance for one who understands,.
sn7.3:3.1: Thereby makes things worse for himself:
sn7.3:3.2: One who repays an angry man with anger.
sn7.3:3.3: Not repaying an angry man with anger,
sn7.3:3.4: One wins a battle hard to win.
sn7.3:4.1: He practises for the welfare of both:
sn7.3:4.3: When, knowing that his foe is angry,
sn7.3:5.1: When he achieves the cure of both:
sn7.3:5.3: The people who consider him a fool
sn7.3:6.1: When this was said, the brahmin Asurindaka Bhāradvāja said to the Blessed One:
sn7.3:6.4: And the Venerable Bhāradvāja became one of the arahants.
